paradigms.name: Autonomous & Agentic OSINT
paradigms.description: Agents plan, select tools, iterate, correlate and synthesize under explicit scope and human review.

paradigms.name: Local-First & Zero-API OSINT
paradigms.description: Inference and sensitive analysis are kept on analyst-controlled infrastructure while dependence on paid external APIs is minimized.
risks: false sense of privacy when external collection still occurs

paradigms.name: Emerging-Source Intelligence
paradigms.description: New intelligence value is extracted from source classes that were previously overlooked or treated as operational exhaust.

paradigms.name: Continuous Multimodal Intelligence
paradigms.description: Systems ingest and verify continuously changing video, imagery, audio, geospatial and text streams instead of analyzing isolated artifacts.

paradigms.name: Decentralized Intelligence Networks
paradigms.description: Intelligence exchange, validation or coordination is distributed across peer-to-peer or decentralized infrastructure.
